Read at about 3x; child's name and godparents' surnames are not firm.

rows.title: Karlobag, 16 January 1733 — Antona, daughter of «Sime» (index) or Dume (?) Uroda and his wife EVA
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1770 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 57, left-hand page (book page 100, headed «Na 1 Genvara 1733»): the third entry, «Na 16 Genvara 1733»
rows.says: «Na 16 Genvara 1733: Ja Pop Andrij Kolekar Plovan krstih sina [Sime / Dume?] urode i njegove xene Eve imenom Antona. Bi kum Andro Kum[anovich?] soldat od Tortice … a kuma …». The FamilySearch index reads this father as SIME Uroda (baptism 16 January 1733, parents Sime Uroda and Eva). The first letter of the father's name is not firm: it may be a Dume with the capital misread. If it is Dume, Dume and Eva had Antona in January 1733, a child in March 1734 and Franica in December 1739. The same page is repeated on image 56 (duplicate frame).

rows.title: Karlobag, 12 January 1737 — «kuma Eva xena Dume urode» (godmother, wife of Dume Uroda)
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1770 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 70, right-hand page, lower half: the entry «Na 12 Jenora 1737», third from the foot
rows.says: «Na 12 Jenora 1737: Krstih cher Jve Berondicha [?] njegove xene Eve … ime Gasparina. Bi kum Mato Mato[vich?] a kuma Eva xena Dume urode.» Not a baptism of the Urodas' child: it shows Eva as Dume Uroda's wife in January 1737, between the 1734 baptism and the Franica of December 1739, so the Eva of 1733–39 is one woman. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 7 June 1739 — marriage of Martin Svjata and Simona, daughter of the late DUME URODA «od Šibenika» (of Šibenik)
rows.film: Karlobag marriages (Vjenčani) 1736–1804 (DGS 5481649, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-HZK)
rows.where: image 279, left-hand page: the entry headed «Dan 7: Junija», after the year heading «Letta 1739» and the entry of 28 May
rows.says: «Dan 7: Junija. Andrij Kollekar Plovan sakupih u S. Matrimonij Martina Svjata [Sviata?] y Simonu pokoi[nog] Dume urode od Sibenika. Biha svidoki Tavia Kovacevich y Bartul Misich.» The wording matches the book's formula for a bride «Heer pokoi X» (daughter of the late X), though the word «Heer» is not written here. So: a DUME URODA from Šibenik, dead by June 1739, with a daughter Simona. The living Dume Uroda of the Karlobag baptisms (wife Eva, daughter Franica baptised December 1739) cannot be this man, so this is a second Dume Uroda — possibly the living Dume's father or another relation, not established — and the first sight of the family as Dalmatian. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Drniš, 13 March 1770 — Josepha, daughter of PAMPAO Uroda and Mariana Bachi, both soldiers
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1770 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 68; index record 1:1:QKMG-2TSF)
rows.where: the left-hand page of the opening, the second entry from the top, headed «Die 13 Martii 1770»; the margin names her «Josepha Uroda»
rows.says: «Ego Fr. Josephus Jakick Capuc. Baptizavi infantem natam sub die primae ejusdem [mensis], ex legitimis Conjugibus Pampao Uroda, et Mariana Bachi, Militum [Illustrissimi?] Domini Capi[tanei] Dulatti [?]. Cui nomen impositum Josepha. Patrinus fuit Stephanus Susszek et Catharina uxor Francisci Pasquali, omnes Militas.» A Franciscan baptises a girl born on the 1st of the month. The father is written PAMPAO (the index reads «Janpao»; 1778 reads «Pompio»), the mother's surname Bachi, and the household is a SOLDIER's, as are the godparents: a military family at Drniš, not a Karlobag one. The words after «Militum» (the captain's name) are not firm. Read at about 4x.

rows.title: Drniš, 26 August 1778 — Julia Magdalena, daughter of CAPORAL Pompeo Uroda and Maria Anna Bachi
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1778 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 112; index record 1:1:QKMG-2VW7)
rows.where: left-hand page of the opening, the entry headed «Die 26 Augusti 1778» that follows the first of two entries of that date
rows.says: «Die 26 Augusti 1778. Ego Fr. Elias Soldich Parochus Darnisii baptizavi infantem natum sub die 23 ejusdem, ex legitimis Conjugibus Caporal Pompeo Uroda et Maria Anna Bachi. Cui nomen impositum Julia Magdalena. Patrini fuerunt Domina Magdalena et Dominus Serdar Antonius Nachich hujus Parochiae.» The father is called CAPORAL — a corporal — and the godfather a SERDAR, a Venetian-Dalmatian militia rank: the same soldier household as in 1770, now spelled POMPEO. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Drniš, 23 October 1780 — Joseph, son of Domino CAPORAL POMPEO Uroda and Maria Anna Bauchi, all soldiers
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1780 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 122; index record 1:1:QKMG-2D3D)
rows.where: right-hand page of the opening, the entry at the top, headed «Die 23 Octobris 1780»
rows.says: «Die 23 Octobris 1780. Ego Fr. Elias Soldich Parochus Curae Darnisij baptizavi infantem natum sub die 13 hujus, ex legitimis Conjugibus Domino Caporal Pompeo Uroda et Domina Maria Anna Bauchi. Cui nomen impositum Joseph. Patrinus fuit Dominus Angelus Sarich et Anna Maria …chin, omnes Milites.» THE INDEX READS THE FATHER AS «TOMASO»; THE PAGE READS POMPEO — so the Drniš baptisms of 1770, 1778 and 1780 are one man, Corporal Pompeo (Pampao) Uroda, and his wife Maria Anna Bachi/Bauchi, a soldier's household. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 2 July 1767 — Petrus Jacobus, son of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the criminal judge Antonius Dorliga and the wife of Antonius Iurich
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 161, left-hand page (book page 290, headed «Anno Dni 1767»): the first entry, «2 July»
rows.says: «Ego Joannes Antonius Ivancovich Parochi Administrator baptizavi [Petrum] Jacobum filium legitimum jugalium Georgii et Mariae Uroda natum die 29 [Junii]. Levantibus e sacro fonte Dno Antonio Dorliga, Judice Criminali ac Dna [..]cica conjuge Dni Antonii Iurich.» The line is clipped at the right by the page curvature, so the child's first name and the godmother's own surname are not firm. The father's neighbours are officials, not kin that can be named.

rows.title: Karlobag, 28 December 1769 — Heva Joanna, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the Chancellor Josephus Kumanović and Sancina, wife of Antonius Dorliga
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)

rows.says: «Ego Jacobus Mallinarich Capellanus baptizavi Filiam die 28 hujus Mensis natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Parochiae, cui impositum est nomen Heva Joanna. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Cancellarius Josephus Kumanovich et Dna Sancina Dorligo Antonij uxor.» (The margin says 25; the text says 28.)

rows.title: Karlobag, 29 April 1772 — Maria Catharina, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the Chancellor Josephus Kumanović and his wife Joanna
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 187, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1772»: the entry «29 ejusdem [Aprilis]», third on the page
rows.says: «Rendus Dnus Jacobus Mallinarich Capellanus Cesaricensis baptizavit filiam heri natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Parochiae cui impositum est Nomen Maria Catharina. Patrini fuere Dominus Josephus Kumarovich Cancellarius cum sua Dna Conjuge Joanna.» The same Chancellor as in 1769.

rows.title: Karlobag, September 1773 — Maria Heva, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda, «hujus loci Civibus»; godparents Antonius Pomsick and Aloysia, wife of Josephus Collini
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 191, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1773»: the entry near the foot, before the first of October
rows.says: «Idem Admin[istrator] baptizavit Mariam Hevam filiam ante quinque dies natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda hujus loci Civibus. Patrini de sacro fonte suscipientibus Dno Antonio Pomsick et Dna Aloysia conjuge Dni Josephi Collini.» The parents are called citizens (Cives) of the town.

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 June 1780 — Antonius, son of Dno Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the standard-bearer Antonius Klein and Catharina, wife of the pro-tribune Joannes Kallinich de Zirfeld
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 214, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1780»: the last entry, «13 ejusdem» [June]
rows.says: «Idem qui supra Baptizavit Filium anteheri Natum ex Dno Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Antonius. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Vexillifer Antonius Klein, et Dna Catharina Conjux Dni pro Tribuni Joannis Kallinich de Zirfeld.» Both godparents are of the military garrison.

rows.title: Karlobag, 17 May 1784 — a son, Dominicus Christianus Joannes, of Dno Georgius and Dna Maria Uroda; godparents Nicolaus Samanich and Heva, wife of Joannes Butorović
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 229, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1784»: the second entry after «2 Moÿ», «17 ejusdem»
rows.says: «Idem qui supra Capellanus loci baptizavi filium [heri] natum ex Dno Georgio et Dna Maria Uroda conjugibus hujus loci Parochiae. Cui impositum est nomen Dominici Cristiani Joannis. Levantibus e sacro fonte Dno Nicolao Samanich et Dna Heva uxore Dni Joannis Butorovic.» Georgius and Maria are Dominus and Domina here. The index lists this child as «Joannis».

rows.title: Pag, 14 March 1728 — Caietanus Antonius Gregorius, son of Dno ANGELO BACHI, patrician, and Dna Oliva — a candidate for the Caetanus Bachi who married at Karlobag in 1753
rows.film: Pag baptisms, 1728 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994; index record 1:1:XQMM-RTYT)
rows.where: right-hand page of the opening, the last entry, headed «Anno Dni 1728 die 14 Martii»
rows.says: «Anno Dni 1728 die 14 Martii. Ego Frater Gregorius … de licentia Rmi D. D. Joannis Franc. Mirovich Archiepi … baptizavi infantem natum die 12 eiusdem [mensis] de legitimo matrimonio procreatum ex Dno Angelo Bachi Patricio, et Dna Oliva Filia Dni Gasparo Lizavola [?] conjugibus. Cui imposui nomen Caietanus Antonius ac Gregorius. Patrini fuerunt Dns Laurentius Cassius [?] Strenuus Miles nomine Illmi ac Excmi Domini Antonij Zane dignissimi Comitis hujus civitatis Pagi, et Dna Lucia …» The father is a PATRICIAN of the island town of Pag, and the child is named CAIETANUS — the rare given name of the Caetanus Bachi who married Anna Lukatelli at Karlobag on 4 February 1753, aged 24 if this is he; a daughter of his at Karlobag is called OLIVA, like the mother here. (The tree's Angelo, ahnentafel 428, comes only from a DIFFERENT Karlobag baptism of 1779 — a Caetanus Antonius, son of Angelo and Catharina — so he is not evidence for this link; see the 1779 snapshot.) NOT PROVED: the Karlobag entries never name his father or birthplace, and the tree's mother is «Catharina». Pag lies a short crossing from Karlobag. The godfather's title and the mother's father's surname are not firm. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 17 May 1780 — Vitus, son of Paulo and Barbara Smojver, «hujus Civitatis»; godparents Simon Matthievich and Margarita Damiani Budak
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 214, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1780»: the entry «17 ejusdem», after the 15th and before the 22nd (the month, May, is by its place on the page)
rows.says: «17 ejusdem. M.R.D. Michaël Martinjazi Baptizavit Filium hodie Natum ex Paulo & Barbara Smojver, Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Viti. Patrini fuerunt Simon Matthievich & Margarita Damiani Budak.» A Paulus Smojver again at Karlobag, now with a wife Barbara (1763: Ursula) and written without the by-name «Vukić». Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 12 January 1779 — Caetanus Antonius, son of Angelo and Catharina Bachi; godparents the Captain Joannes Jankovich and Maria, wife of Dno Georgius Uroda
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 210, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1779»: the entry «12 Januarij», the third from the top
rows.says: «12 Januarij. M.R.D. Michael Martinaj Presbyter Curatus Loci Baptizavit infantem hodie natum ex Angelo & Catharina Bachi conjugibus hujatibus, cui impositum est nomen Caetani Antonij. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Capitaneus Joannes Jankovich et Dna Maria uxor Dni Georgij Uroda.» THIS IS THE BAPTISM THE TREE WRONGLY TAKES FOR THE ELDER CAETANUS BACCHI (ahnentafel 214, born 1779 «maybe»): a different, younger Caetanus Antonius, son of ANGELO and CATHARINA — a second Bacchi household at Karlobag in 1779 — and the godmother is MARIA, wife of Dominus Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 109). Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Betina, 28 November 1835 — Andrea, son of Simeone Uroda and Giovanna Barran, both «a Betina»
rows.film: Betina baptisms, 1835 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 19; index record 1:1:QKMG-896Y; the printed Italian «Libro degli atti di nascita», Distretto di Sebenico, Circolo di Zara)
rows.where: left half of the printed table, entry no. 24; the second entry (no. 23) is Andrea and Nicolò, children of Antonio Moikin
rows.says: Printed form, Italian: «Nato li 28 [ventotto] Novembre 1835 … Battezzato li 28 … Andrea» — masculine, legitimate; mother «Giovanna [Barran] a Betina»; father «Simeone Uroda a Betina»; the parents' marriage (25 February 1835, Betina) and the godfather «Andrea Barazic a Betina» in the columns to the right. The parents are Catholic and live at Betina, in the Šibenik district under Austrian Dalmatia, and nothing on the page says they came from anywhere. The 1829 baptism of Maria «Urodan» (image ref. 20) and the 1839 baptism of Antonio «Urada» (ref. 33) are the same printed form and were opened but add no origin. A resident Betina family of the 19th century, not a Karlobag one. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, «30 [Oct or Nov] 1739» — Jakomo, son of a Jakov Pilipić; godparents Gn. Mik[ula] Zorović and Kate, wife of Gn. Antun Dorliga
rows.film: Karlobag births (Rođeni) 1691–1804 (DGS 5481648, FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-3Y9)
rows.where: image 82, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Na 30: [month] 1739»
rows.says: «Na 30: [Ovra] 1739: Korstih ja Plovan Andrij Kollekar korstih [sina] Jakova Pilipicha imenom Jakomo … [word not read: a place, perhaps «u kaštel»] … bi kum Gn. Mik[ula] Zorović a kuma Kate [Blizi?] Gn. Antona Dorliga.» THE INDEX DATES IT 30 NOVEMBER; THE MONTH WORD (an abbreviation ending «-ovra») COULD BE OCTOBER OR NOVEMBER AND IS NOT FIRM. The child's father is named «Jakov Pilipić» and the godparents are the town's gentry (Zorović; the wife of Antun Dorliga, who in 1767 is the criminal judge) — a man of standing, which fits a captain of the port. NO MOTHER IS NAMED. Several words in the middle of the entry are not read at this resolution. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Šibenik, 3 June 1767 — marriage of Joannes Grubisich and Ariana, daughter of the late Michael Boydanovich alias Pancora; the witnesses include «Dno Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik cathedral parish marriages 1752–1787 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-W3R, 468 images)
rows.where: image 373, left-hand page, the first entry, headed «Anno Domini 1767 die vero 3tia mensis Junii»
rows.says: «Ego Presbyter Josephus Caristo Rector Ecclesiae Parochialis S. Benedicti … Joannem filium Michaeli Grubisich ex Parochia Sanctae Mariae Vallis Viridis et Arianam [?] filiam relictae q. Michaelis Boydanovich alias Pancora, Parochiae S. Benedicti, in Ecclesia S. Francisci Fratrum Minorum Conventualium interrogavi … matrimonio conjunxi coram Testibus Matthaeo Xeravizza, et Dno Dominico Uroda, ac multis.» The witness's surname is read as Uroda (V-shaped initial, final «a»); the entry gives no father, place or age. The first Uroda seen in the Šibenik registers; NOT shown to be the Karlobag Dominicus or Dume. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 10 August 1762 — marriage of Antonius Loccasovich and Elera Dulitich; the witnesses include «Dno Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 469, right-hand page (numbered 91), the first entry, headed «Die 10 Augusti 1762»
rows.says: «Tribus denuntiationibus dispensatis … Ego Presbyter Thomas Jadovon Rector Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris in Ecclesia Cathedrali S. Jacobi interrogavi Antonium filium Francisci Loccasovich et Eleram filiam Petri Dulitich ambos supradictae Parochiae S. Marci … in matrimonium conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Illmo Domino Angelo Semonich alias Perova, et Dno Dominico Uroda aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; the surname is written with a V-shaped initial and a final «a», the same hand and spelling as the 1767 witness at the cathedral parish. The entry gives him no father, place or age.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 11 September 1759 — marriage of Matthaeus Meich of Zlosela and Antonia, widow of the master Hieronymus Sigovec; the witnesses include «Magistro Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 458, right-hand page (the page after p. 80), the second entry, headed «Die 11 Septemb. 1759»
rows.says: «Duabus denuntiationibus … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Rector Eccl. S. Marci in Suburbio Maris interrogavi in supradicta ecclesia Matthaeum filium qd. Stephani Meich ex Villa Zloseba [Zlosela] Antoniamque relictam qd. magistri Hieronimi Sigoveo, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos solemniter matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Magistro Domico [Dominico] Uroda, et Antonio Lucenti aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; «Domico» is a contracted «Dominico». The title here is «Magister» (a master of a trade), not «Dno» as in 1762 and 1767. No father, place or age is given.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 27 September 1757 — marriage of Matthaeus Kvancich and Lucia, widow of Andreas Segna; the witnesses include «Joanne filio Dominici Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 450, right-hand page (numbered 75), the entry headed «Die 27 Septemb. 1757», which ends at the foot of the page
rows.says: «Tribus denunciationibus dispensatis ab Reverendissimo Vicario Generali Nicolao Difnico … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Rector Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris, in Ecclesia S. Rochi, interrogavi Matheum filium qd. Joannis Kvancich et Luciam relictam qd. Andreae Segna, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Joseph Fevetti, et Joanne filio Dominici Uroda, aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x. **A son of a Dominicus Uroda, Joannes, of an age to witness in 1757** (the first mention of a Uroda child in the Šibenik registers); the entry does not say who Joannes is, how old, or that the Dominicus is the Dominicus of 1759–1767. Names with doubtful letters: «Kvancich» and «Segna».

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 11 January 1756 — marriage of Silvester (or Saulus) Clavich and Dominica, daughter of the master Joannes Kinchela; the witnesses are «Dominico Uroda et Michaele Cigo»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 446, right-hand page, the entry headed «Die 11 Januarii 1756» at the foot of the page (the page after the one numbered 69)
rows.says: «Die 11 Januarii 1756. Tribus denuntiationibus praemissis … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Parochus Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris interrogavi in supradicta Ecclesia Silvestrum vel Saulum filium Stephani Clavich, et Dominicam filiam magistri Joannis Kinchela, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Dominico Uroda et Michaele Cigo aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; the first name of the groom is doubtful. The earliest of five sightings of a Dominicus Uroda at Šibenik (1756, 1757, 1759, 1762, 1767), here with no title.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 19 May 1738 — baptism of Lucia, daughter of Michael and Mathea Dragovich; the godmother is «Dna [Su]guetia, uxor Mri Georgij Vroda» (wife of the master Georgius Uroda)
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 117, left-hand page, an entry in the lower half, headed «Die 19 Maji 1738»
rows.says: «Die 19 Maji 1738. Lucia filia Dni Michaelis et Mathee coniugum Dragovich ex hac P[arochi]a S. Marci, in lucem edita die 13 [Maji], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me Franciscum Can[onicu]m Parchych … cui impositum fuit [nomen Lucia]. Patrini fuerunt Philippus Defrateo, et Dna Guetia [the name is unclear, perhaps Suguetia] Uxor Mri Georgij Vroda.» Read at about 3x. **A Magister Georgius Uroda, already married, in Šibenik in May 1738**: the first mention of any Georgius Uroda at Šibenik, and 25 years before the Georgius of Karlobag has a first child. The wife's name is not read with certainty; she is not named Maria. Whether this is the Georgius of Karlobag (ahnentafel 108), his father, or a namesake is not shown.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 12 October 1738 — baptism of Maria, daughter of Antonius and Margareta Vidovich; the godfather is «Magister Franciscus Vroda» (the master Franciscus Uroda)
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 118, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Die 12 Octobris 1738» (the margin reads «Maria Vidovich»)
rows.says: «Die 12 Octobris 1738. Ego Presbiter Nicolaus Mijagostovich Vice Parochus S. Marci Baptizavi in Baptisterio dictae Parochiae infantem natam sub die 7 Septembris ex Conjugibus Antonii et Margerita Vidovich cui impositum fuit nomen Maria; Patrini fuerunt Magister Franciscus Vroda, et Marta [Marchiani?].» Read at about 3x; the first godparent is a Magister Franciscus Uroda (the surname with the same V-shaped initial as the Dominicus sightings), the godmother's surname is a guess. A second master of the name at Šibenik in 1738, five months after the Magister Georgius Uroda of 19 May.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 30 January 1735 — baptism of Domica, daughter of Joannes and Antonia [surname Maraglia?]; the godparents are «Franciscus Vroda» and Simona [Suraeovich?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 111, right-hand page (numbered 4), the second entry, headed «Die 30 Januarii 1735»
rows.says: «Die 30 Januarii 1735. Domica filia Joannis et Antoniae coniugum Maraglia [?] ex hac Par[ochia] S. Marci, in lucem edita die 21 [Januarii], Bap[tizata] fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me … Parochi … Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Franciscus Vroda, et Simona Suraeovich [?].» Read at about 3x; the child's surname and the godmother's are doubtful; **Franciscus Uroda**, here without «Magister», is the same name as the master of October 1738, three years earlier. The earliest sighting of any Uroda at Šibenik.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 25 April 1733 — baptism of Maria, daughter of Joannes and Anastasia [surname Maraglia?]; the godparents are «Mr Franciscus Vroda» (the master Franciscus Uroda) and Anastasia [Signorin?]

rows.where: image 109, right-hand page, the third entry, headed «Die 25 Aprilis 1733» (the margin reads «Maria Maraglia»)
rows.says: «Die 25 Aprilis 1733. Maria filia Joannis et Anastasiae coniugum Maraglia [?], in lucem edita die 20 [Aprilis], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri Baptisterio per me Franciscum Parchych S. Marci Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Mr Franciscus Vroda, et Anastasia Signoria [?].» Read at about 3x; «Mr» is a contraction of Magister; the child's and godmother's surnames are doubtful. **The earliest sighting of any Uroda at Šibenik (1733)**, the same Franciscus who stands godfather to Joannes and Antonia's Domica in January 1735 and, as «Magister», to Antonius and Margareta Vidovich's Maria in October 1738.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 1 January 1741 — baptism of Joana, daughter of Thomas and Lucia Peresich alias Bodulovich; the godparents are «Magister Dominicus Vroda» (the master Dominicus Uroda) and Dominica, daughter of Matthaeus Marchovich

rows.where: image 123, right-hand page (numbered 17), the first entry, headed «Die 1ª Januarii 1741» (the margin reads «Joana Peresich alias Bodulovich»)
rows.says: «Die [1] Januarii 1741. Joana filia Tomae et Luciae Conjugum Peresich alias Bodulovich ex hac Parochia S. Marci in lucem edita die 30 Decembris, Baptizata fuit in hoc Parochiali Baptisterio per me V[ice] Parochum Nicolaum Mijagostovich, cui praescriptum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Magister Dominicus Vroda, et Dominica filia Matthaei Marchovich.» Read at about 3x. **The earliest sighting of Dominicus Uroda (1741), already a «Magister»**, 15 years before he appears as a witness at Dolac marriages (1756–1762). The Dolac godfather of Šibenik's Uroda: Franciscus (1733, 1735, 1738), Georgius (1738 as a godmother's husband), Dominicus (1741).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 6 May 1742 — baptism of Georgius, son of Joannes [Presrou?] de Flumine alias Biliznich and of Antonia, «filia q[uondam] Francisci Vrodda de hac Parochia S. Marci» (daughter of the late Franciscus Uroda)

rows.where: image 126, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Anno Domini 1742 – Die 6 Maij» (the margin reads «Georgius Biliznich»)
rows.says: «Anno Domini 1742 – Die 6 Maij. Georgius filius Joannis [Presrou?] de Flumine, alias Biliznich, et Antoniae filiae q[uondam] Francisci Vrodda de hac Parochia S. Marci, Coniugum, natus die 17 mensis Aprilis proxime elapsi. Baptizatus fuit in hac Parochiali Ecclesia S. Marci per me Angelum Trapileo; cui impositum fuit nomen Georgius, [ut supra]. Patrini fuere Viscardus Pini, et Dna Cecilia Vidovich q[uondam] Caroli.» Read at about 3x; the father's second name is doubtful. **Antonia is the daughter of the LATE Franciscus Uroda of Šibenik**: so Franciscus (godfather 1733, 1735, 1738) was dead by April 1742, and had at least this daughter, who married a Joannes Biliznich of the same parish. The child is a Georgius Biliznich, not a Georgius Uroda.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 23 April 1741 — baptism of Domica, daughter of Joannes and Antonia Maraglia [?]; the godparents are «Mr Dominicus Vroda» (the master Dominicus Uroda) and Maria Vergada [?]

rows.where: image 125, left-hand page, the first entry, headed «Die 23 Aprilis 1741» (the margin reads «Domica Maraglia»)
rows.says: «Die 23 Aprilis 1741. Domica filia Joannis et Antoniae coniugum Maraglia [?] ex hac Par[ochia] S. Marci, in lucem edita die prima supradicti [mensis], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me Franciscum Parchych … Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Mr Dominicus Vroda, et Dna Maria Vergada [?].» Read at about 3x. **Magister Dominicus Uroda is godfather to a child of the same couple (Joannes and Antonia/Anastasia Maraglia) as Franciscus Uroda was in 1733 and 1735**: the families are bound together, perhaps by kinship, and so, perhaps, are the two Uroda men. The earlier Domica of 30 January 1735 (same parents) presumably died.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), January 1703 — baptism of Paulus, «procreatum ex Joanne Vroda, et Ursula eius conjugibus» (son of Joannes Uroda and Ursula); godparents the master Hieronymus [Magaznich?] and Jacobina, wife of the master Melchior [Bayrinich?]

The godparents' names are doubtful.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 14 May 1706 — baptism of Paulus, son of Thomas and Anastasia Vrodich [Urodić]; godparents Marcus and Catarina, spouses [Liatich?]

Patrini fuerunt Marcus et Catarina Conjuges Liatich.» Read at about 3x; «Vrodich» is clear, the mother's name is read as Anastasia. **A third Uroda household at Šibenik 1703–1706 (Joannes and Ursula; Lucas; Thomas and Anastasia)**: the surname was common in the Dolac suburb in the first years of the book.

Philippus Servovich.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 23 October 1710 — baptism of Paulus, son of FRANCISCUS and Anna Vrodich [Urodić], «Conjugum Catholicorum»; godparents Dno Joannes Theodorovich and Jacoba Bonacich

rows.says: «Die 23 8bris 1710. Paulus filius Francisci Vrodich et Annae Conjugum Catholicorum, Baptizatus fuit per me Fr. Philippum Servovich Parochum eccl. S. Marci. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Joannes Theodorovich et Jacoba Bonacich.» Read at about 3x. **The first appearance of the name Franciscus Uroda, with a wife Anna and a son Paulus, in 1710**; the Magister Franciscus of 1733–1738 (dead by 1742, daughter Antonia) is very probably this man, who by 1733 would be a father of grown children, or his son of the same name. Three Paulus Uroda are baptised in the first decade of the book (1703 son of Joannes, 1706 son of Thomas, 1710 son of Franciscus).

rows.says: «Die 28 8bris 1715. Ego Fr. Philippus Surcovich Parochus Vicarius S. Marci in Suburbio Maris Sibenicensis, in eadem Ecclesia Baptizavi infantulum procreatum ex legitimo matrimonio sub die 21 eiusdem mensis, ex Lucia [?] et Francisco Vrodich de eadem Parochia. Cui nomen impositum fuit Simona. Patrini [fuerunt] D. Georgius Vrodi[ch?] Gasparovich [?] …» Read at about 3x; the mother's name (Lucia?) and the godfather's second surname are doubtful. **A daughter SIMONA of a Franciscus Vrodich in 1715**, with a Georgius (a Vrodi-) as godfather; this Franciscus has a different wife's name from the Franciscus and Anna of 1710 and 1712 (a second marriage, or two Franciscus). The dead «Dume Uroda of Šibenik» of the 1739 Karlobag marriage had a daughter SIMONA who married then; the name is a coincidence at most.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 19 October [?] 1721 — baptism of FRANCISCUS ANTONIUS, son of Franciscus URODE and Anna, born 3 of the month; godparents D. Petrus Mioćević and his wife Dominica

Read at about 4x; the surname is written plainly «Urode». **A son of a Franciscus Urode and Anna in 1721** — the wife's name of the Franciscus of 1710 (Paulus) and 1712 (Stanislava), who are therefore probably this man; the 1715 Simona's mother was read «Lucia?» (a second wife, or the reading is wrong).

(A Georgius VIDOVIĆ, with a wife Stanislava, is also a godfather in these pages; he is not an Uroda.)

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 15 December 1744 — baptism of LUCIA, daughter of MAGISTER DOMINICUS and FLORIA VRODA, born 12 December; godparents D. Antonius Bellagamba and a Magister Dominicus

Patrini fuere D. Antonius Bellagamba locum tenens Libratorid [?], et magister Pellio [?] Dominicus». Read at about 4x; the word after «magistri» (Dolcarij / Doleari) may be a trade (a cooper) or a by-name, and the godfather's surname is doubtful. **A Magister Dominicus Vroda is a father, with a wife Floria, in December 1744.**

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 16 May 1745 — baptism of VITTORIA, daughter of DOMINICUS and FLORIA VRODDA, born 10 [May]; godparents Joannes Piaggio and Antonia Zanoli alias Bellagamba

Patrini fuere Joannes Piaggio, et Antonia Zanoli alias Bellagamba ambo de hac Parochia». Read at about 4x; the same couple as the Lucia of December 1744 (Dominicus and Floria Vroda).

Marci baptizavi in hoc Parochiali Baptisterio infantem natam die prima mensis currentis, ex legit.o matrimonio vid.t ex Coniugibus Joannis Mestrouich alias Calafat et Antoniae Vrodda ambo de hac Parochia, cui impositum fuit nomen Franceschina. Patrini fuere Illmus D. Julius Viddouich nobilis Scardonen. et Illma D. Maria Bonacich similiter nob. Scardonen., ambo de hac Parochia». Read at about 4x. **An Uroda daughter, Antonia, married to a Joannes Mestrovich alias Calafat** (a Magister Joannes Mestrovich alias Calafat «de Villa Stobrec» stands godfather in 1747).

Patrini, Dominicus Vroda, et Elisabeth Soldin ex hac Parochia. Cui nomen impositum est Antonia». Read at about 4x; the parish priest of 1746–1752 is a different man from the Trapileo of 1744–45.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 20 March 1752 — baptism of Josephus, son of Thomas and Lucia Bodulovich, born 26 February; godparents DOMINICUS URODA and Justina Mlix [?]

Februarij ex Thoma et Lucia Bodulovich leg. con. huius loci, cui nomen impos. est Josephus. Patrini Dominicus Uroda, et Justina Mlix [?] ex hac Cura». Read at about 4x; the surname is written «Uroda» here.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 6 July 1755 — baptism of Vitus Antonius, son of Aloysius and Mathea Pajanin, born 11 June; godfather Joannes Matheus Miocevich, and «assistens DOM. DOMINICUS VRODA»

Patrini fuerunt Dominus Joannes Matheus Miocevich, et assistens Dom. Dominicus Vroda». Read at about 4x; «assistens» is a second sponsor or a witness to the rite.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 13 February 1757 — baptism of Lucia, daughter of Matheus and Elena Pajanin, born 16 October 1756; godparents D. DOMINICUS, SON OF THE LATE GEORGIUS VRODA, and Bartholomea, wife of Nicolaus Save

rows.says: «Die 13 Februarij 1757. Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovou Parochus Eccl. S. Marci in Suburbio Marij, baptizavi in Baptisterio supradictae Ecclesiae infantem natam die 16 Octobris anni 1756 ex Coniugibus Matheo et Elena Pajanin, cui impositum fuit nomen Lucia, patrini fuerunt D. Dominicus filius qd. [quondam] Georgij Vroda, et Bartholomea Uxor Nicolai Save». Read at about 4x. **«Dominicus, son of the late Georgius Vroda»: the only entry of any register read that names a father of a Šibenik Uroda master, and it says the father was dead by February 1757.** Whether this Dominicus is the Magister of 1741, 1745–55 and 1756–67 is not stated; he is written «Dominicus» and no trade is given.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 11 September 1757 — baptism of Helena, daughter of Matheus and Margarita Raich, born 10 August; godfather DOMINICUS VRODA, PICTOR (a painter), and Josephus Maverci

Marci in Suburbio Marij, Baptizavi in Baptisterio supradictae Ecclesiae Infantem natam die decima Augusti anni supradicti, ex coniugibus Matheo, et Margarita Raich, cui impositum fuit nomen Helena. Patrini fuerunt Dominicus Vroda Pictor, et Josephus Maverci». Read at about 4x; «Pictor» (painter) is a trade written beside the name. A Dominicus Vroda in a different trade from the «Magister» of the 1740s; whether one man or two is not shown.

Marci Suburbij Maris Baptizavi infantem natam die 13 [?] ex Laurentio et Lucia [Vlovich?] cui nomen impositum est Anastasia ex dicta Parochia. Patrini fuerunt Dominicus Vroda et Catarina uxor Thome Vrodich». Read at about 4x; the surname is spelled Vroda in the first and Vrodich in the second. **The earliest Uroda in any Šibenik register read: two men, a Dominicus and a Thomas, in April 1687, the second married to a Catarina.**

Read at about 4x; the forename of «Dominus Vrodich» is not given (the Dominicus Vroda of 1687, 1692, 1693 is the likely man; his wife is Ursula in July 1692).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 2 December 1691 — baptism of Catharina, daughter of Stephanus Sintich and Lucia, born 25 November; godparents Joannes Rupcich and ANASTASIA, WIFE OF PAULUS VRODA

Patrini fuerunt Joannes Rupcich & Anastasia coniunx Pauli Vroda omnes ex hac Parochia Sancti Marci». Read at about 4x. **A Paulus Vroda, married to an Anastasia, in December 1691.**

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 31 July 1692 — baptism of LUCIA, daughter of DOMINICUS VRODI and URSULA, born 28 July; godparents Franciscus Amadeo alias Pepich of this city, and Margarita, wife of Franciscus Stanisich

Marci Baptizavi infante nata sub die 28 huius ex Dominico Vrodi, & Ursula coniugibus: Cui nomen impositum est Lucia. Patrini fuerunt Franciscus Amadeo alias Pepich ex hac Civitate, & Margarita uxor Francisci Stanisich ex hac Parochia Sancti Marci». Read at about 4x. **A Dominicus Vrodi with a wife Ursula and a daughter Lucia in 1692.**

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 2 August 1692 — baptism of Elias, son of Andreas Boghcrich [Bogherich] and Joanna Vidovich, born 31 July; godparents Narcissus Crinelosi [Cimelosi] and JUSTINA, DAUGHTER OF THOMAS VRODA

Read at about 4x. **A Thomas Vroda who has a daughter old enough to be a godmother in 1692** (so married by about 1675).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 6 August 1692 — baptism of ANTONIUS, son of LUCA VRODI and MARIOTA, born 3 [August]; godparents Andreas Stanisich and Antonia, wife of Andreas Franini

Read at about 4x. **A Lucas Vrodi with a wife Mariota in 1692** — the Lucas Vrodich of 1705 and 1710, or his father.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 17 September 1692 — baptism of Joannes, son of Elias Galiotovich and Helena Stanisich, born 29 August; godparents Petrus Gechich and CATHARINA, WIFE OF THOMAS VRODA

Omnes ex hac Parochia Sancti Marci». Read at about 4x. **Thomas Vroda's wife is Catharina** (as in April 1687).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 22 February 1693 — baptism of Catharina, daughter of Joannes Croglienich and Hieronyma, born 19 [February]; godparents DOMINICUS VRODI and Ursula, wife of Hieronymus Trapilei

Patrini fuerunt Dominicus Vrodi, & Ursula uxor Hieronymi Trapilei. Omnes ex hac Parochia Sancti Marci». Read at about 4x. The godmother Ursula is the wife of a Hieronymus Trapilei, so she is not Dominicus's wife (Ursula, July 1692) unless the entry runs two names together.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 24 August 1693 — baptism of Paulina, daughter of Stephanus and Lucia Miglianich; godparents PAULUS VRODA and Stanislava [?], his wife

Patrini fuerunt Paulus Vroda et Stanislava [?] uxor eiusdem». Read at about 4x in a new hand (Fr. Bonaventura Bilogla[v], from August 1693); the wife's name is doubtful (Stanislava, Veonislava). **Paulus Vroda is married to an Anastasia in 1691 and to a «Stanislava» [?] in 1693** — a different wife, or one name misread.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 17 September 1693 — baptism of AURELIA, daughter of «Domini» [Dominici?] and Silvia [?] VRODA; godparents Simeon Vidovich and Vicentia Vidovich

Patrini fuerunt Simeon Vidovich et Vicentia Vidovich». Read at about 4x; **doubtful in two places**: «Domini» may be a short form of Dominici (the Dominicus Vrodi of 1692, whose wife was Ursula, not Silvia) and the mother's name is not clear.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), July 1695 — baptism of Joanna, daughter of Stephanus [?] and Lucia Tintich [?]; godparents D. HIERONYMUS TRAPILEUS and STANCA VRODA

Gerolimus Trapileus et Stanca Vroda». Read at about 4x; the date and the parents' names are doubtful, **the godmother «Stanca Vroda»** is clear. A Stanca [Stanislava?] Vroda may be the Stanislava, wife of Paulus Vroda (1693).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 5 May 1696 — baptism of Jacoba, daughter of Franciscus [?] and Michaela Michel [?]; godparents D. Franciscus Stanisich and LUCIA VRODNA [Urodna?] (doubtful)

Franc. Stanisich et Lucia Vrodna». Read at about 3x; the second surname may be Vrodna, Urodna or another word (**doubtful** and recorded only as such).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 13 July 1698 — baptism of MICHAEL, son of LUCAS and MARIETA VRODICH; godparents Joannes Bratich and Juanippo [?] Anetich
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1685–1700 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R24-1XW, 41 images; the first book, cover «Liber Baptizatorum 8 Oct 1685 – 1700»)

Patrini fuerunt Joannes Bratich et Juanippo [?] Anetich ambo ex dicta Parochia». Read at about 4x; the margin note gives the child's name and surname «Michael Vrodich». **A Lucas Vrodich with a wife Marieta, a son Michael in 1698** (a Lucas Vrodi with a wife Mariota had a son Antonius in 1692).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 13 November 1701 — marriage of LUCAS, SON OF THE LATE ANTONIUS VRODA, and Francisca, daughter of the late Joannes Loveta
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images; the book's cover reads «Šibenik, župa Dolac, vjenčani 6/2.1701–8/4.1764»)
rows.where: image 372, right-hand page, the entry headed «Die 13 Novembris 1701» in the upper half
rows.says: «Die 13 Novembris 1701. Lucas filius qm Antonij Vroda contraxit matrimonium per verba de presenti cum Francisca filia qm Joannis Loveta ex hac Parochia S. Marci, presente me fre Andrea Rinich [?] … et testis Dno Jacobo …». Read at about 4x; the first line's second word is written «Lucas» and the father's forename is a clear «Antonij». **A Lucas Vroda, son of the late ANTONIUS Vroda, marries a Francisca in 1701** — after the Mariota of 1692 and the Marieta of 1698, so a widower's second marriage (or two Lucases); the Simeon of 1705 and the Paulus Antonius of 1710 follow in the baptisms.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 8 January 1702 — marriage of THOMAS VRODICH and Anastasia, daughter of Jacobus Vitich [?]

rows.says: «Die 8 Januarii 1702. Thomas Vrodich ex hac Parochia S. Marci contraxit matrimonium per verba de presenti cum Anastasia filia qm Jacobi Vitich [?] ex Antiq[ua?] … post solitas tres denuntiationes, presente me fre Andrea Rupich …». Read at about 3x; the bride's father's name and place are partly lost to the worn edge. **Thomas Vrodich marries an ANASTASIA on 8 January 1702 — the Thomas and Anastasia whose son Paulus is baptised on 14 May 1706**; he had a wife Catarina in 1687 and 1692, so this is a second marriage (or a second Thomas).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), [1 or 7] October 1710 — marriage of ANTONIUS, SON OF THE LATE PAULUS VRODICH, and Anna, widow of the late Antonius Ivanitich

Contraxit sacrum matrimonium per verba de presenti Antonius filius qdm Pauli Vrodich cum Vidua Anna uxore qdm Antonij Ivanitich [?] pro tribus denuntiationibus in propria habitatione sui sponsi … presente me Fr. Andrea [?] … Parocho S. Marci …». Read at about 3x; the day number and the late husband's name are doubtful. **A son Antonius of a PAULUS Vrodich, dead by 1710** — the Paulus Vroda of 1691–95 (wife Anastasia/Stanislava), so his son is a groom in 1710.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 7 February 1717 — marriage of Nicolaus Sesanovich and Thomizza, widow of the late Marcus; the witnesses include Christophorus Cornich and «Franc[iscus] Vrodich»

rows.says: «Die 7 februarii 1717. [Denuntiationibus] duobus omissis cum dispensatione … Nicolaus Sesanovich ad … Thomizza relicta qdm Marci … Presente me fr. Philippo Surcovich Parocho … et testibus … D. Christophoro Cornich, frane Vrodich [?], et omnibus aliis». Read at about 4x in a faint hand; the witness's forename is abbreviated and may be Franc[iscus] (the Franciscus Vrodich of the baptisms 1710–1721) — **doubtful**.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 30 October 1718 — marriage of ANTONIUS, SON OF LUCAS VRODICH, and Antonia, daughter of Matthaeus Merra [?]

Michaeli … et D. Marcus fili[us] …». Read at about 4x. **A son Antonius of a Lucas Vrodich** — the Antonius baptised 6 August 1692 would be 26.

Franciscus Parchych Dre Ecclesie Rector, eorum mutuo consensu habito solemniter per verba de presenti matrimonio conjunxi. Presentibus testibus Dno Anto Carisso, et Franco Vroda». Read at about 4x. **The Franco Vroda who stands at the font from 1725 (the «Mr. Franciscus Vroda» of the baptisms) is a witness here the same month.**

Presentibus testibus Dno Georgio Bonacich, et Mro Domco Vroda multisq. alys». Read at about 4x; the heading and the couple's names are on image 419. **A Magister Dominicus Vroda (the «Mr Domcus Vroda» abbreviation of 1726) is a witness in January 1739** — two years before the godfather of 1741.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 4 August 1746 — marriage of Matheus Darin of Jasana and Vincentia Pavicich, servants of the noble Julius Viddovich; the witnesses include «DOMINICO VRODDA, FILIO MAGISTRI GEORGII DE HAC PAROCHIA»

rows.says: «Anno Dni 1746 – Die 4 Aug. Omissis tribus denuntiationibus ex facultate mihi tradita … Ego Angelus Trapileo Paroc. Ecclesie S. Marci huius sub Urbii Maris … interrogavi Matheum Joannis filium Aloysii Darin de Jasana nunc servus Ill.mi D.Co. Julij Viddovich Nob. Scardon. et Vincentiam filiam qm Marci Pavicich de Villa Verbagna Diecesis Lesine … Presentibus testibus Ill.mo D. Georgio Viddovich Nob. Scardon., Ill.mo D. Aloysio Simeonech Nob. Sibenicen. et DOMINICO VRODDA FILIO MAGISTRI GEORGII DE HAC PAROCHIA, multisq…». Read at about 4x. **«Dominicus Vrodda, son of Magister Georgius» — the same Dominicus whose father is «the late Georgius Vroda» in February 1757. So Magister Georgius Uroda of Dolac was ALIVE on 4 August 1746 and dead by 13 February 1757.**

Dominici Fratrum Praedicatorum.» Read at about 4x; the second word after the forename is faint and may be «Infans». **A child of a Magister Georgius Vroda dies in October 1740** — and no baptism of a Magdalena (or any child of a Georgius Uroda) is in the Dolac baptism book of 1731–1744 (images 108–129, read), so she was baptised in another parish or not entered.

Marci, cuius corpus sepult[um fuit …]». Read at about 4x; the forename is crowded against the margin. **A Magister ANTONIUS Vroda, alive [«Magistri», not «qm»] in January 1742** — the Antonius baptised 6 August 1692 (son of Lucas) who married Antonia on 30 October 1718.

Marci, cuius corpus sepultum est in Ecclesia S. Dominici Fratrum Praedicatorum.» Read at about 4x. **The wife is named: Antonia — as in the marriage of Antonius, son of Lucas Vrodich, and Antonia on 30 October 1718**; a daughter of about 13 is born about 1729.

Marci.» Read at about 4x; the abbreviation after «Lucia» is read «ux.» (wife), which would make her the widow of a **Magister Dominicus Vrodda dead by 21 June 1746** and born about 1669 — so the elder Dominicus Vroda of 1687–1693 (wife Ursula, before) or a master of the same name.

Dominici Fratrum Praedicatorum.» Read at about 4x. **The only Georgius Vroda found dying between August 1746 and August 1754 in a read of images 241–254, and so very probably the Magister Georgius alive on 4 August 1746 and dead by 13 February 1757** (images 255–262 of the book, to February 1757, were not read). Aged about 60 → born about 1694.

rows.title: Šibenik cathedral (S. Jacobi), baptised 10 October 1694 — GEORGIUS, born 6 October 1694, son of DOMINICUS and LUCIETTA VRODA; margin «Georgius Vroda»

Ego Joannes Bapta Chiochius alias Monticelli Vicarius … Baptizavi infantem natum sub die 6 Octobris 1694 in Parochia Divi Jacobi, cui impositus nomen Georgius ex Coniugibus Dominico et Lucietta Vroda; Patrini fuerunt Illmus Dominus Hieronymus Sopra[?] et Domina Franceschina uxor Excellmi Domini Vicenty de Dominis.» Read at about 4x; the surname is written «Vroda» in the text and in the margin. **A Georgius Vroda aged «60» died at Dolac on 17 August 1754 (image 254); a boy born 6 October 1694 would have been 59 years 10 months old that day.** The parents' names, Dominicus and Lucietta, match the elder Magister Dominicus Vrodda and his widow Lucia, aged about 77 at death on 21 June 1746, of the Dolac parish.

rows.title: Šibenik cathedral (S. Jacobi), January 1694 — MICHAELA, daughter of MAGISTER LUCAS and MARIA VRODA; margin «Michaela Vroda»
rows.film: Šibenik cathedral parish (S. Jacobi) births 1693–17.. (FamilySearch waypoint 9R28-SPJ, the «Liber Baptizatorum 1693–», cover at image 260; the baptisms of the Dolac suburb were also done in the cathedral baptistery)

Ordinarij infantem natam sub die … cui impositum fuit nomen Michaela filia Magistri Lucae et Mariae Vrodal. Patrini fuerunt Thomas … Joannes Ingurovich et Vitus uxor Hieronimi Trapilei [?].» Read at about 4x. A Dolac household baptised at the cathedral baptistery with the Ordinary's leave: the Lucas Vrodi × Mariota of the Dolac books (Antonius 6 August 1692, Michael 13 July 1698) is the likely couple, but the Dolac baptism books carry no Michaela — so a Dolac family's children may be missing from the Dolac books.

rows.title: Šibenik cathedral (S. Jacobi), 14 [October] 1696 — SIMEON, son of MAGISTER DOMINICUS and LUCIA VRODDA of the Dolac suburb parish (S. Marci); margin «Simeon Vroda»
rows.film: Šibenik cathedral parish (S. Jacobi) births 1693–17.. (FamilySearch waypoint 9R28-SPJ, the «Liber Baptizatorum 1693–», cover at image 260; the baptisms of the Dolac suburb were also done in the cathedral baptistery)
rows.where: image 286, left-hand page, last entry (margin «Simeon Vroda»), headed «Die 14 dicti 1696»
rows.says: «Ego Abbas et Canonicus Joannes Vilcovich [?] … in Basilica Divi Jacobi ex Parochia Divi Marci Suburbii, a Reverendo Domino Bono Vicario, infantem natum die … ex Coningibus Magistro Domco ac Lucia Vrodda; cui impositum fuit nomen Simeon: Patrini fuerunt Lucas … Joannes Dugovich [?] Locumtenens Militum Lombardorum et Domina Maria uxor … Domini Gubernatoris.» Read at about 4x. **The same pair as Georgius's parents of 1694 — Dominicus (Magister) and Lucia — now written as of the parish of S. Marci, i.e. the Dolac household of the elder Magister Dominicus Vrodda, whose widow Lucia died aged about 77 on 21 June 1746.** The day-of-month and the month are partly lost; the page runs through October 1696.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 15 November 1738 — death of MAGISTER FRANCISCUS VRODA, buried in the church of the Holy Trinity

Magister Franciscus Vroda munitus Sanctissimis Sacramentis per Rev.dum Vicarium Parochum Nicolaum Miagostovich animam Deo reddidit, cuius corpus sepultum fuit in Ecclesia Parochiali Sanctissimae Trinitatis.» Read at about 4x; the day-of-month reads 15 (the entry after it is also dated the 15th). **The Magister Franciscus Vroda who stood godfather at Dolac on 12 October 1738 and was dead by 6 May 1742 (his daughter Antonia, wife of a Joannes Biliznich): he died a month after his last sighting.** The Magister Franciscus Vroda of 1725–1738 and the Franciscus Vrodich × Anna of 1710–1721 are very probably one man; not shown.

rows.title: Šibenik cathedral (S. Jacobi), 7 June 1740 — ceremonies supplied for JOSEPH JOANNES, born 16 December 1739, son of MAGISTER DOMINICUS and FLORA VRODA of the parish of S. Marci; margin «Joseph Joannes Vroda»

Marci in suburbio maris supplevi reliquas ceremonias in Baptisterio eiusdem Cathedralis infanti nato die 16 Decembris anni praeteriti 1739 ex coniugibus Magistro Dominico et Flora Vroda Parochiae S. Marci, cui impositum fuit nomen Joseph Joannes, qui infans ritu baptismi fuit domi a parentum ob imminentis mortis periculum a Reverendo Domino Nicolao Miagostonich … Parocho dictae Parochiae S. Marci; cui assistentes fuerunt Joseph Fontana … et Magister Dominicus Gersovich parochiae S. Spiritus.» Read at about 4x; a few words are uncertain. **A first child of Magister Dominicus and Flora (the Floria of the Dolac books, whose Paulus, Lucia and Vittoria follow in 1744–45), baptised at home for danger of death and the ceremonies supplied at the cathedral; he is very probably the «Joannes filius Dominici Uroda», old enough to witness a marriage on 27 September 1757.**

Maii proxime elapsi … fuit in [casa] … ab … baptizari ex licentia … S. Marci … ceremoniae supplerae … cui impositum nomen Anna; Patrini … Julia Vidovich et … Joannes Antonius [Scolini?].» Read at about 4x; the middle of the entry is hard to read and the day of birth is doubtful. A second child of Dominicus and Flora, in no Dolac book.

rows.title: Pag, 19 January 1764 — death of DNUS ANGELUS BACCHI, apothecary («Aromatarius»), aged about 68

Matris Ecclesiae, cuius corpus sepultum est in Ecclesia totius [?] Insignis Collegiatae … confessus … Dno Cancellario Joanni Mestrovich … Sacramento Eucharistiae … annorum circiter 68.» Read at about 4x; the place is Pag by the index and by the Collegiate church; the register does not name the town in this entry. **Born about 1696 — the age of the Dno Angelo Bachi, patrician, whose son Caietanus Antonius Gregorius was baptised at Pag on 14 March 1728; the trade, apothecary, is new.** No son is named. The Caetanus Bachi who married at Karlobag on 4 February 1753 was dead by October 1760, so this death says nothing about him.

rows.title: Nin, 6 October 1768 [the index says 1767] — death of DNA VIENA BACHI, who died suddenly and was buried in the chapel of the B.V.M. delle Purine

rows.where: a spread of the deaths register in Italian, right-hand page, near the foot (the entry before 14 ottobre 1769)
rows.says: «Addì 6 ottobre 176[6/8]. Passò da questa a miglior vita Dna Viena Bachi la quale morì di morte improvvisa e fù sepolta in capella della B.V.M. delle Purine.» Read at about 5x; the last digit of the year is not firm (the entries around it run 1768–1769; the index says 6 October 1767). **A Bachi household at NIN in 1768–1787** — the index has two more Bachi burials in the same book, Elisabetta (12 May 1777) and Antonio (23 November 1787, with a Filippo Carleva) — Nin lies on the mainland across from Pag. Whether it is the Pag family of Angelo Bachi is not shown.

rows.title: Karlobag, October 1715 — a son LUCA baptised to MIKULE BACH[…]; the index reads «Bachi??»
rows.film: Karlobag births 1691–1804 (FamilySearch, DGS film 005481648; index record 1:1:QKMX-YL4S)
rows.where: left-hand page, first entry, headed «Na 2? oktobra 1715» (a Croatian-language entry by the priest Anton Hreljanović)
rows.says: «Na [2]1 oktobra 1715. Ja pop Anton Hreljanović krstih sina Mikule [Babi — struck out] Bach[…], imenom Luca, komu bi kum Volfa Ivich, a kuma njegova mat Marija.» Read at about 5x; the surname is cut by the edge of the left page after «Bach» and the scribe struck out a first spelling, so **«Bachi» is the index's reading, not a firm one — it may be Bačić or another name**. The name Luca is a man's (Luka) here, though the index files it as a woman. If it is Bachi it is a Bachi at Karlobag 38 years before the marriage of 1753, and the Caetanus of 1753 need not have come from Pag.

rows.where: image 567, left-hand page, 1855 June, twenty-seventh day, first entry on 567L

The Latin-language 1855 pages of the Senj death register (the book «Knjiga Mertvih od God. 1849», Državni arhiv Zagreb, Zbirka matičnih knjiga Br. 1118; from February 1855 each entry is written out in full: «Anno Domini 1855 die N [month] Segniae obiit in Domino: [name], [age], e [cause], omnibus moribundorum Sacramentis provisa, et sepulta est in communi Coemeterio St. Viti, comitante Antonio Lukovich [or Laurentio Verhovac] Cooperatore loci»), image 567 left page, the first entry. A woman born about 1795 who came to Senj from Baška on the island of Krk and died there of dysentery in the cholera summer of 1855; the Žubrinić of Baška are a family this archive follows, and the register says in so many words that she was «oriunda» (native) of Baška

rows.title: Senj births, str. 122, entry 96 — Milka Lucia Papić, born 9 and baptised 17 October 1886
rows.film: Senj births (Rođeni) 1878–1894 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2D-JWL, 269 images)
rows.where: image 140 of 269, left-hand page: entries 94–97, the date and name columns above and the parents' column of the right-hand page below
rows.says: Entry 96: «1886 listopada 9. / 17.» — Milka Lucia — zakonita; parents (right-hand page): «Josip Papić, trhonoša, i Tonka rođ. Prpić», rim. kat. The month is written once, «listopada» (October), across both columns, so she was born 9 and baptised 17 October 1886. Entry 97 beneath it: «1886 listopada 27. / 31.» — Kate — parents «Jaso Špalj, težak, i Ana rođ. Prpić». The FamilySearch index of this volume gives Milka's dates as 9 and 17 NOVEMBER and Kate's as 27 November: it has read «listopada» as November (listopad is October; studeni is November). The tree's baptism date of 19 October is a slip for 17. Re-read 16 October 2026 from the image at full resolution; first read 10 September 2026.

rows.title: Otočac status animarum, the Kraljich household, house No. 40 — «Nicolaus filius defti Jacobi», born «29 9bris 1807»
rows.film: Otočac Church Census (Stanje duša) 1710–1846, filmed with Deaths 1780–1836 and Marriages 1859–1872 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2D-16X, 384 images)
rows.where: image 76, left-hand page (printed archive number 319), the first household on the page, house No. 40, the first six rows: Georgius Kraljich at the head, then the entries for Nicolaus, Matthaeus, Franciscus, Georgius and Stephanus
rows.says: «[No. 40] Georgius Kraljich · 29 Martij 1778 · [struck, carried to house No. 53] Nicolaus filius defti Jacobi · 29 9bris 1807 · «845» · Matthaeus · 5 Febr 1812 · Franciscus filius Georgij · 12 Junij 1814 · Georgius · 17 April 1814 · [struck, No. 53] Stephanus filius defti Jacobi · 7 7bris 1817 · «845»». «Defti» = defuncti, «of the late»: the father Jacobus was dead by the time the line was written. Nicolaus's month is written «9bris», the Latin abbreviation for Novembris (the same glyph stands on Vitus's row at house No. 53, and Stephanus's «7bris», September, is a visibly different glyph on the row below it there); the tree has Nicolaus on «29 SEP 1807». Nicolaus's date is repeated at house No. 53 (image 86): see the snapshot otocac-census-kraljich-house-53-nicolaus-adoptatus. The dates and the numbers beside them were read at about 0.55x and the month glyph at full size; the year digits of Georgius (1778), Franciscus and the second Georgius were read once and are not firm. The household's own relationships (who Georgius Kraljich was to the brothers) are not stated on the page.

rows.title: Otočac status animarum, house No. 40 — the children «Josephus filius Nicolai», Georgius (19 April 1836) and «Petronilla filia Nicolai» (26 May 1838)
rows.film: Otočac Church Census (Stanje duša) 1710–1846, filmed with Deaths 1780–1836 and Marriages 1859–1872 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2D-16X, 384 images)
rows.where: image 76, left-hand page (printed archive number 319), the lower rows of the same household (house No. 40): Thomas, Michael, Josephus, Georgius, Petronilla, Clara
rows.says: «Josephus filius Nicolai · 28 8bris 18[3?]· [struck] Georgius filius dicti · 19 April 1836 · Petronilla filia Nicolai · 26 Maij 1838»: the census source of the tree's «Georgius Kraljich b. 19 April 1836» and «Petronilla b. 1838». The father is entered only as «Nicolai»; that he is the Nicolaus of the rows above is the tree's reading and is not stated on the page. The year of Josephus's date was not read.

rows.title: Otočac status animarum, house No. 53 (Matthias Dujmović) — «Nicolaus adopt. Kraljić ex N° 40», «Stephanus frater Nicolai», their children and wives
rows.film: Otočac Church Census (Stanje duša) 1710–1846, filmed with Deaths 1780–1836 and Marriages 1859–1872 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2D-16X, 384 images)
rows.where: image 86, right-hand page (archive frame 329), the first household on the page, house No. 53: sixteen rows from «Matthias Dujmovich» to «Maria filia Stephani»
rows.says: «53 Matthias Dujmovich · 31 Jan 1768 · Vitus filius dicti · 1 9bris 180[7?] · Nicolaus filius Viti · 3 10bris 1837 · Nicolaus adopt[atus] Kraljić ex N° 40 · 29 9bris 1807 · Stephanus frater Nicolai · 7 7bris 1817 · Georgius filius Nicolai · 19 April 1836 · [struck] Maria uxor Matthiae · Catharina filia Gregorii Dujmovich · 6 Martii 1800 · Maria uxor Viti · Lucia filia Viti · 6 Junii 1836 · Felicitas uxor Nicolai nata Banich · Francisca filia Viti · Mathia uxor Stephani nata Žubrinić · [struck] Petronilla filia Nicolai · 1838 · Vincentia dicto · 12 Martii 1840 · Maria filia Stephani · July 1848». The adoption note repeats Nicolaus's date from house No. 40. The month glyphs of Nicolaus (9bris) and Stephanus (7bris) were compared at full size. Which Nicolaus is the husband of Felicitas is not stated (the only other Nicolaus in the house is a child of 1837); that Vincentia and Petronilla are Nicolaus's daughters is from the rows, not from a stated mother. Felicitas's surname «Banich» is read once.

rows.title: Otočac status animarum, house No. 40 — «Anna uxor Nicolai · 5 7bris 1809» (struck)
rows.film: Otočac Church Census (Stanje duša) 1710–1846, filmed with Deaths 1780–1836 and Marriages 1859–1872 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2D-16X, 384 images)
rows.where: image 76, right-hand page (archive frame 319), the first rows of house No. 40, the fifth row, above «Lucia filia Francisci · 4 Julii 1845»
rows.says: «Anna uxor Nicolai [struck] · 5 7bris 1809»: no maiden name entered. The birth date is the tree's date for Anna Žubrinić Xubrinich, to the day; the name Žubrinić is not on this page. She is in house No. 40, in the run of rows that begins «Maria uxor Francisci», and which Nicolaus she is the wife of is not stated (the Nicolaus of house No. 40 with children Josephus, Georgius and Petronilla is the likeliest).
